en: Hymn to the One Possessing the Six Superknowledges:

Perfect in the marks of physical form, you associate with the lowly, the high, and those of equal status; you always manifest the perfection of giving—homage to you, O one who has reached the further shore of generosity! (1)
Complete in the characteristics of sound, most beautiful, an ocean of virtues—always proclaim the moral discipline; homage to you, O one who has reached the further shore of discipline! (2)
O Leader, endowed with the perfect characteristics of fragrance and possessing divine breath, grant us the patience of the Victors; homage to you, who have reached the further shore of patience! (3)
Perfectly endowed with the characteristics of flavor, possessing a beautiful tongue, you are the teacher of the Dharma;
speak the Dharma of the Sugata! Homage to you, who have reached the further shore of vigor! (4)
Complete with the characteristic of contact, unceasing and effortless, touch the meditative absorption, O Jina; homage to you, who have reached the further shore of meditation.
Perfectly endowed with the characteristics of the Dharma, you who contemplate all beings with equanimity;
O you who have attained great wisdom and skillful means, homage to you, the one who has reached the further shore of intelligence!
Whoever, full of devotion, recites this hymn to the one possessed of the six superknowledges at the three junctions of the day, shall cast off the bonds of saṃsāra and attain the supreme goal. (7)
The hymn of praise to the six supernormal knowledges of the venerable Lord Mahābuddha is completed.
